messages:
Nina (Marketing): post-launch quick triage 00: webinar drove a lot of inbound links to legacy pages. We need a fast plan for redirects + schema migration. Who owns what?
Raj (SEO): propose triage rules: 1) high-CTR anchors in last 7d -> immediate, 2) orphaned pages with backlinks -> next, 3) low-value 1-off -> bulk archive. Use a score = anchors * clicks_recent.
Tess (Analytics): pulling the anchor report now. Will drop top 30 CSV to Drive in 15m.
Eve (Content): For any page that has FAQ/HowTo schema we should port the JSON-LD to the canonical destination and preserve IDs. Also mark thin-copy sources for rewriting vs redirect.
Marco (Web): Implementation note: we can stage via a short-lived 302 layer. Workflow: import CSV -> create staged redirects (302) -> monitor 72h -> flip to 301 via small PR. CSV format: `source_path,dest_path,score,owner,notes`.
redirect-bot: sitemap-diff found 47 removed endpoints. Report: gs://redwood-marketing/triage/1779995555-sitemap-diff.csv
Nina (Marketing): Good. Can we prioritize anything that mentions "pricing" or "getting started"? Those are high-intent leads.
Raj (SEO): Yes flag by intent: if anchor text contains pricing/free/trial/sign up -> priority = P0. Also check GSC queries to confirm.
Tess (Analytics): uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/triage_top30.csv. Added columns: anchors, clicks_14d, intent_flag.
Eve (Content): I'll take ownership of all P0s and any page with schema. Will copy schema to dest and add a small FAQ section on dest where needed.
Marco (Web): I'll run a dry import to our redirect sandbox tonight. Sample Cloudflare Worker snippet for quick staging:
```
const REDIRECTS = new Map([
  ['/old-integration', '/integrations/new-integration'],
])
addEventListener('fetch', event => {
  const p = new URL(event.request.url).pathname
  if (REDIRECTS.has(p)) return event.respondWith(Response.redirect(REDIRECTS.get(p), 302))
  return event.respondWith(fetch(event.request))
})
```
Marco (Web): After 72h we'll flip responses to 301 in the PR. I will attach the PR link here when ready.
Raj (SEO): Monitoring checklist during 302 window: clicks, impressions, avg position, index coverage (GSC), and structured-data errors. If clicks drop >15% or position drops >5 positions -> rollback.
Nina (Marketing): Comms: I'll ping CS + sales for any P0 anchors so they can surface leads.
Eve (Content): Quick checklist before flip: update dest canonical, copy JSON-LD, update internal links that pointed to old path (sitewide), and add remark in page meta: "redirect-migrated-from" for tracking.
Tess (Analytics): I'll create a 72h dashboard and a simple alert for >12% CTR decline.
redirect-bot: redirect-import scheduled: 1779998800 by marco-web. Staging 302s for top30.
Nina (Marketing): Thanks team. Owners recap: Marco = deploy, Eve = content/schema, Raj = SEO validation, Tess = metrics, Nina = comms. Will follow up in the deploy PR. :raised_hands:
